implementation_notes: Use domain nouns for entities and domain verbs for behaviour (`approve()`, `cancel()`, `settle()`), and a domain-named enum for lifecycle states. DTOs and persistence entities live in infrastructure packages named as such, so the domain vocabulary stays uncontaminated.
idiom_name: domain nouns/verbs in the domain package; infrastructure vocabulary elsewhere
pitfalls: JPA-generated getters (getX, setX) replacing domain verbs in the entity
